verdict.rationale: Reflect's note-history doc says edits are continually recorded, so users can see all changes and revert a note to any point in time. That covers viewing version history and restoring earlier versions. The evidence is a single first-party line, and nothing addresses recovering deleted notes. Missing for 10: documented recovery of deleted notes (trash/undelete), detail on the history UI and retention, independent or hands-on corroboration.
